known_errors.title: List of identified bugs and limitations
known_errors.description: Here are the known issues in the current versions of Proto-Typed. Track their status and suggested solutions.
known_errors.indentationErrorDescription: When there is a blank line, it is understood as the end of the parent component's indentation, causing a failure in the correct rendering of styles in the dark theme.
known_errors.indentationErrorCause: Problem in the parser that understands blank lines as the end of a block
known_errors.foundNewIssueDescription: Report a bug or unexpected behavior so we can investigate and fix it as quickly as possible.

principles.title: Proto-Typed — describe interfaces, see prototypes, iterate with AI.
principles.description: A textual prototyping format: you write what the interface is (screens, lists, buttons, navigation) and the system takes care of the rest — no dragging blocks, no JSX, no friction.
